summary:
Form only: plan.md is written, nothing is built yet. Buff limestone masses follow the lidar setbacks (31-storey slab with a crown, a broad flat Music Hall deck with a raised stage house, an 18-storey east end). Continuous piers frame dark window strips, and every flat roof is lit.
It reads as Radio City from the street frontage: a 4-tall marquee wraps the Sixth Ave/50th St corner in a red neon line, alternating RADIO CITY / MUSIC HALL letters, a blue neon line and gold bulbs. A 22-tall blue-and-silver blade sign with stacked red RADIO CITY letters rises from the marquee at the corner; three enamel roundels sit above the 50th St run.
Planned departures from the brief: the lidar's 2-wide strip along Sixth Ave becomes the marquee zone, and the plot 1 frontage wall above the marquee stands 2-3 blocks back from the lot line.
